title: Agreement before a timeout
statement: Let $H$ be a Turing machine with state set $Q$, let $S$ be a finite type, and let $\mathrm{timeout}:\mathrm{Option}(S)\to Q$. If a run of $H$ from configuration $a$ avoids every state $\mathrm{timeout}(r)$ for all times strictly before $t$, then for every $u\le t$, the runner machine started from $a$ with its active-mode flag set agrees with the run of $H$ through time $u$, including the configuration state with that flag set.
